spacing.rule: Intentional padding around content. Dense list items but readable. Sticky CTAs at bottom with safe-area padding.

do's: Sticky top header over scrolling content

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette derived from the provided logo: Royal Blue (#2563EB) for primary branding/headers and Vibrant Orange (#F97316) for primary conversion CTAs (Add to Cart, Checkout).
Material 3 compliance: Use tonal layering for components (elevation 0). Use Pill shapes (radius 999) for primary buttons and chips. Use large rounded corners (md/lg) for cards.
Implement a fast, dense 'Amazon/Blinkit' inspired layout for the Home Screen. Prioritize search bar, location, and swipeable banners. Use sticky Add-to-cart patterns.

Ensure 'fly-to-cart' animation is implemented using `react-native-reanimated`. When user clicks 'Add to Cart', an animated element flies to the cart tab icon, followed by a haptic `notificationSuccess` and an animated badge increment.
Use Skeleton loaders (`expo-linear-gradient` with reanimated) for Home and PDP loading states. Do not use generic spinners for content feeds.
The notification bell in the header must have an animated badge (subtle pulse or bounce on new notification).
All interactive elements (buttons, quantity steppers, cart icons) must have `hitSlop` of at least 44x44 and trigger defined haptics.
Ensure bottom tabs have a glassmorphism effect using `expo-blur` / `expo-glass-effect` for a premium feel as requested.
